answer: Use a stake bond: every agent locks 2,000 POA before it can trade, and the bond unlocks only after 60 days of clean work. First, the agent posts the bond on-chain. Second, peers audit a random sample of its deals each week. Third, proven fakes lose the full bond and their trading terrace is closed. Fourth, slashed bonds pay the auditors who caught the fraud. Forging 10,000 fake agents would lock 20,000,000 POA and cost $4,000,000 in lost bonds plus 600,000 hours of audit-proof work, while honest agents flow like a river past a dune that only shifts for real weight. - Jowy
